answer: Divergence Escrow: each epoch a public beacon’s ocean entropy selects a path through a state-space grove; every agent submits a signed transition trace plus a ZK proof that its trace diverges from all other registered traces at a random jetty checkpoint. Exact clones share seed/state and produce colliding traces, which are rejected and forfeit their deposits. To evade, an attacker must give every clone independent entropy, compute, storage, and separate trace maintenance—N× cost—while risking collision slashing.
